question: By what percentage did the measured NO emissions rise when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
question_long: In the bubbling fluidized bed, by what percentage did the measured NO emissions rise when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
rendered:
According to page 10, the measured NO emissions rose from 169 ppm to 308 ppm when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0. 

To calculate the percentage increase: ((308 - 169) / 169) * 100 = 82.5%.
